_about: The FeedbackInput the app sends after every set (lib/analysis/contracts.ts, built by feedbackInput in lib/save-and-analyse.ts). Each value here names the type; docs/feedback-input-example.json is a real one. A list shows one element.

profile.medical_history: string, "None" allowed; the advice must be safe for it

rules.name: string, the rule name that violations[].rule refers to, e.g. "knee_valgus"
rules.check: string, the engine check it runs
rules.debounce_s: number, seconds a frame rule must hold; 0 for rep rules

threshold.<key>: number, the rule's bar, keys named per check

messages.en: string, the warning shown and spoken to the user

earlier_sets: SetSummary, the sets of this workout before this one, oldest first

set.set_no: integer, a repair set keeps its set's number

totals.correct_reps: integer, the counter; only correct reps count

similarity.mean_score: number 0-100, one decimal, mean over the scored reps
similarity.mean_score_correct: number 0-100 | null, mean over the scored reps the rule engine judged correct (no warning fired); null when there were none
similarity.mean_score_incorrect: number 0-100 | null, mean over the scored reps the rule engine judged incorrect (a warning fired); null when there were none

body_parts.<part>: number 0-100; only the parts this exercise is scored on: squat and lunge torso, left_leg, right_leg; push-up torso and arms; curl the working arm

similarity.weakest_body_part: "torso" | "left_arm" | "right_arm" | "left_leg" | "right_leg" | null, the lowest mean part; the torso reads lower even on good reps
similarity.model: string, the model that scored it; scores from different models do not compare

reference.kind: "builtin" | "package", what the reps were compared with; scores against different references do not compare
reference.source: string | null, which take or set

set.feedback: string | null, the feedback already written for this set (null while it is being written)

attempts.frame_start: integer | null, index into the keypoint file

violations.state: string | null, the engine state when it fired

threshold.<key>: number, the bar it was measured against

rep_stats.<name>: number, the engine's measurements for the rep; keys starting with _ are internal

similarity.score: number 0-100 | null; null means the rep could not be scored, so do not judge form from it

body_parts.<part>: number 0-100, same parts as the set

similarity.skipped_reason: string | null, why score is null
warnings: string, tracking problems in this rep
similarity.tracking_confidence: number 0-1 | null, how well the camera saw the rep

set._abandoned_attempts: an abandoned attempt has "similarity": null as a whole

_history_note: the user's last 5 workouts of this exercise, newest first, this one excluded

SetSummary.similarity: as set.similarity, or null when the set was not scored
